comment: Expected row counts (post-dedup unique lines) for secondary register lines per fiscal year, used by the row_count_fy validator. Set to null for FYs where the actual count has not yet been established. Update after first verified ingest. FY2023-24 count is post-dedup (Data Sheet + Data-Sheet tabs; June tab is a copy removed by in-memory dedup). FY2024-25 and FY2025-26 use a single Data Sheet tab (no dedup needed). State Head Dashboard FYs are not counted here — those are validated by the all_months_present and anomaly validators instead.
